figurative_meaning_en: An utter fool or extreme idiot
similar_in_english: Not the sharpest tool in the shed
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এত বড় মূর্খ যে উদর চিরলে ক বেরোয় না।
এই কাজটা করতে গিয়ে তার উদর চিরলে ক বেরোয় না বুঝতে পারলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: He is such an utter fool that if you cut open his stomach, 'k' won't come out.
From his mistake, I realized he is an extreme idiot with no brains inside.
note: The idiom plays on Bengali script and literacy, implying profound ignorance where even basic knowledge is absent.
